blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — With the Senate Impeachment Court ruling to lower the threshold needed to convict Vice President Sara Duterte, Presiding Officer Francis Escudero has laid down specific conditions on who will not be allowed to vote once they decide on the case. After the oral arguments on Wednesday, 13 senator-judges present voted to lower the number of votes required to convict Duterte. They also agreed that the denominator that will be used to determine a two-thirds vote will rely on how many members of the Senate are available.
